verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services firm that advertises status dashboards and People Ops integration, so asking for a programmatic API spec is a fair question. However, no evidence shows a published OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The 'plug into your People Ops' claim describes service coordination, not a documented API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
